project.title: Bramble Books: the online shop
project.standfirst: A made-up project showing what a Topping Out board looks like a few weeks in: an independent bookshop moving its catalogue, orders and stock online. Every job, number, quote and commit on this page is invented.

head.outcome: A customer can buy a book online, and stock never goes negative.
head.test: An order placed on the live site reaches the shop's packing list within a minute, and the stock count drops by exactly one.

owed: Search ranks exact title matches below fuzzy ones (board 03's lens inspection; the owner deferred it to after launch).
The dispatch email has no plain-text version yet.
Password reset emails are not rate-limited per address (board 02's cross-model review; accepted as a debt until go-live).
The catalogue import keeps no record of which spreadsheet a title came from.
Basket expiry runs on page load, not on a schedule: an idle basket outlives its 30 days until its owner returns.
alerts: Board 07 needs the owner's decision: refunds by card only, or store credit too?
facts: Payments run in the provider's test mode until board 09.
Stock is counted per shop, not per shelf.
Every build job so far took four to six work orders.

lesson.title: A green probe means the test doesn't test the guard
lesson.rule: When removing the stock guard left every test passing, the builder stopped and reported instead of re-aiming the probe. The missing test was the real finding.

jobs.title: Catalogue import
jobs.summary: Imports the shop's spreadsheet of 4,200 titles into the catalogue, rejecting rows without an ISBN.
twigs: 37 rows without an ISBN rejected, listed for the owner
jobs.lesson: Count the rows in and the rows out: a silent skip looks exactly like a clean import.

jobs.title: Customer accounts
jobs.lesson: Write the hostile inputs into the work order: the builder tests what it is told to test.

jobs.title: Search
jobs.summary: Title, author and ISBN search over the catalogue.
jobs.lesson: Probe every ranking rule, not just the happy path.

jobs.title: Basket
jobs.summary: Add, remove and change quantities; the basket survives a sign-out and expires after 30 days.
twigs: two-tab race found by the cross-model review

figures.label: repair work orders from the foreman's own mistakes

notes: Owner's word, 2026-10-03 (quoted): "keep a basket for 30 days, not forever". Recorded in the job file before work order 2.
jobs.lesson: Two tabs are two customers: test every shared row from both at once.

jobs.title: Checkout and payment
jobs.summary: Card payment in the provider's test mode; an order is created only after the payment succeeds.

jobs.title: Stock that never goes negative
jobs.summary: Two customers buying the last copy at once: one order succeeds, the other is told it's sold out.

jobs.title: Refund policy
jobs.decision: Refunds by card only, or store credit as well?

jobs.title: Dispatch emails
jobs.summary: An email when the order is packed, with the tracking number.

jobs.title: Go live
jobs.summary: Switch payments to live mode and open the shop.

jobs.title: Delivery zones
jobs.resolution: UK only for launch; the owner will revisit Europe after three months.

jobs.title: Order history
jobs.summary: A customer sees their past orders and can download a receipt.
